messages:
maria: Quick sync — greenroom + tech run-of-show for Wed webinar (Scaling inference: demos & fallbacks). Draft below. Need: mic/test ops, demo proxy failover, ask-lane owners. Ping @ryan for demo script, @sam for load test, @jess for slides, @olivia for greenroom ops.

ryan: On it. Demo script: 8m demo (2m warmup, 5m live, 1m wrap). We should have canary model fallback to smaller q8 model if latency spikes. Who owns fallback switch?

sam: I'll own load test and auto-fallback trigger. Will run a synthetic at 50 rps pre-demo. Need the docker command and endpoints.

maria: thanks — temp plan: if p90 > 1.2s for >30s, flip to fallback. Manual override button in console. olivia please test mic + stream 10min before start.

olivia: Got it. AV checklist: 1) laptop audio test, 2) in-room mic mixing, 3) greenroom Zoom link + backchannel. I'll send invite.

jess: Slides: please add a single slide with 'What to ask' lanes mapping — I'll design. Also need speaker timer color cues: green at 0-6m, amber at 6-7m, red at 7-8m.

ryan: Demo proxy snippet (for sam):
```bash
docker run --rm -e PROXY_TARGET=https://demo.redwood.ai:443 \
  -p 8080:8080 redwood/demo-proxy:stable
# health: curl http://localhost:8080/health
```
Will add fallback URL config.

sam: Perfect. I'll use that. Will also post load test results in this channel.

maria: Ask-lanes: mapping
- sales: lead capture + pricing questions -> @emily-sales
- product: architecture, SDKs -> @ryan
- benchmarks / evals -> @sam
- partnerships / press -> @nina
Make sure to route via backstage slack DM to owners. Add short canned replies.

ryan: Canned replies for product questions:
1) 'Thanks — here's the model card + perf sheet: <link>'
2) 'Can you share your expected QPS & latency SLOs?'

olivia: :thumbsup: greenroom will have the backstage DM list and phone numbers.

greenroom-bot: Reminder scheduled: Greenroom opens 25 minutes before start — 2026-06-10T15:35:00Z

maria: Rehearsal plan: Tues 10:00 PT run-through with speakers + ops. Agenda: slide run, demo rehearse w/ fallback, Q&A routing. Who can't make it?

jess: I can only join first 30m, but will prerecord slide cues.

ryan: All good.

sam: All good.

olivia: I'll be there.

maria: OK locking. I'll update calendar + send rehearsal invite now. Thanks everyone :rocket:
